TRAIN_only_nonpersistent_router_step_pro.teacher_sources: same checked per-domain teachers; TRAIN only
TRAIN_only_nonpersistent_router_step_pro.scope: Three nonpersistent one-router-step numerical probes on same complete TRAIN and fixed head/other phases; no persistent model or TEST/VAL results
TRAIN_only_nonpersistent_router_step_pro.limitations: Fresh Adam states and code0 only; not the running optimizer momentum, all8 D4 or TEST-soft objective. No classification or optimizer convergence claim.

Explicit authorized TEST development selection, not independent testing.
